div.head: Northu 53
div.ab: Gif cyrlisc man ætsæce, þonne nemne man him his gelicena ealswa micel wente swa ðam oðrum; gif him þæt berste, þonne gilde he lahsliht: XII ór.
If a man of the ceorl class denies it, then as many compurgators of his equals are to be nominated for him as for the others; if that fails, he is then to pay lahslit: 12 ores.
If a peasant denies the charge, then just as many witnesses of his same status are to be chosen for him as for the others: if that fails then he is to pay lahslit: twelve ores.

Wenn ein gemeinfreier Mann [das] leugnen will, dann ernenne man [das Gericht] ihm von seinen Standesgenossen ebenso grosse Eideshilfe[?] wie den anderen; wenn ihm dies misslingt, dann zahle er Rechtsbruchbusse: 12 Ör.

If a man of ceorl rank wishes to deny [it], then let [the court] nominate for him from his equals as large a body of oath-helpers[?] as for the others; if that fails him, then let him pay lahslit: 12 ores.
